The full stored document (history, layers, chat), as kept for browser autosave.
The original file exactly as uploaded.

post.description: Step back one step in the history.
Re-apply the most recently undone step.
Record a change made with the manual controls as a named step in the history.

422.description: Invalid, or a generative edit that is not allowed

post.description: Add a recipe's layers on top of the current edits, as one step in the history.

Offer several takes on a generative edit to pick from, as one step in the history.
Each take is generated now, so showing and picking them is instant.

404.description: No such document or generative operation

get.description: A preview of the photo with one of the takes on offer.

404.description: No such document, operation, or take

Add portrait retouch layers (skin, eyes, teeth) on top, as one step in the history;
without options, the subtle defaults.

Level the photo and square up converging verticals, measured from its straight
lines, as one step in the history. 422 when it finds nothing to go by.

Add `?revision=<document revision>` to make the URL unique per edit state; the response

post.description: Render the edits at full resolution and return the file to download.

get.description:
The unedited look with the current framing (crop, rotation, flips) applied, so it lines
up with the preview for before/after comparison.

Where a layer of the current state applies, at preview size, as a grayscale PNG
(white is full effect). Add `?revision=` to make the URL unique per edit state.

AI model jobs running (or just finished) for this document, with their progress.
The web app polls this while it waits on a change.

post.description:
Two to four directions this photo could go in, each as layers with a thumbnail, to
pick from and refine. Proposed by Claude when an API key is set, else built in. The
answer is kept, so asking again for the same edits is free.

get.description: A small preview of the photo with a suggestion applied on top of the current edits.

post.description:
Add a suggestion's layers on top of the current edits, as one step the agent knows
about, so the conversation can carry on from it ("a bit less contrast").

Reopen a saved project: either a `.photoagent` project `file`, or an `original`
photo plus its `graph` (the document JSON), as the browser keeps them for autosave.

The project keeps its id unless another document already has it.
Save a set of layers as a recipe to apply to other photos.

get.description: The built-in looks, each a layer of ordinary adjustments.
Report that the server is up and whether the Claude API key is set.
Every operation with its parameters' ranges, for building manual controls.
Which model (or classical fallback) runs each AI task, and on what device.

level.title: Level
level.description: Level a tilted horizon or tilted verticals.

Blacks.title: Blacks
Blacks.description: Move the black point: negative makes blacks deeper, positive lifts them (matte look).

invert.title: Invert
invert.description: Swap where the layer applies and where it does not.

BrushMask.title: BrushMask
BrushMask.description: Painted by hand: the layer applies where the strokes are.

items.description: [x, y] as fractions of the photo.

size.title: Size
size.description: Brush radius as a fraction of the photo's long edge.

hardness.title: Hardness
hardness.description: 0 is a soft edge, 100 a hard one.

erase.title: Erase
erase.description: Remove from the mask instead of adding to it.

ChatEntry.title: ChatEntry
ChatEntry.description:
One line of the conversation shown in the chat panel and replayed to the agent.

The conversation is linear even when the history branches: undo, redo, and jumps are
recorded as `event` entries, so the agent knows its earlier change is no longer in effect.

step_id.title: Step Id
step_id.description: Step to show, or null for the original photo.

Clarity.title: Clarity
Clarity.description: Add (positive) or soften (negative) midtone local contrast and texture.

shadows.title: Shadows
shadows.description: How strongly the shadows take their hue.

midtones.title: Midtones
midtones.description: How strongly the midtones take their hue.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: How strongly the highlights take their hue.

balance.title: Balance
balance.description: Moves the split: positive gives highlights more of the range.

ColorGrade.title: ColorGrade
ColorGrade.description:
Split toning, as colorists grade film: tint the shadows, midtones, and highlights
each toward a hue (degrees: 0 red, 30 orange, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 210 teal
blue, 240 blue, 300 magenta) by its own amount, keeping brightness. Teal shadows with
orange highlights is the blockbuster look; warm highlights and cool shadows read as
film.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same prompt and seed give the same result; leave it out for a fresh one, or change it for a different take.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that generates it, recorded by the app.

options.title: Options
options.description: Seeds of alternative takes offered to pick from, recorded by the app.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: How strong the new colors are.

Colorize.title: Colorize
Colorize.description:
Colorize a black-and-white photo with an AI colorization model. The photo's own
brightness and detail stay; only color is added. The only operation in its layer.

Contrast.title: Contrast
Contrast.description: Increase or decrease overall contrast around the midtones.

Crop.title: Crop
Crop.description:
Crop to a region of the current frame, optionally locked to an aspect ratio.

The box is given as fractions of the current width and height (0 = left/top edge,
1 = right/bottom edge). With an aspect ratio, the result is the largest rectangle of that
ratio centered inside the box, so a full-frame box plus "4:5" is a centered Instagram crop.

background.title: Background
background.description: Null for a transparent background (PNG export), or a color like "#ffffff".

Cutout.title: Cutout
Cutout.description:
Keeps only what the mask selects (the main subject unless told otherwise) and
replaces everything else with transparency or a solid color.

Dehaze.title: Dehaze
Dehaze.description: Cut through haze or fog (positive), or add atmosphere (negative).

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A photo being edited. Stored as JSON next to the original file.

DocumentView.title: DocumentView
DocumentView.description: What the web app sees of a document.

EditState.title: EditState
EditState.description: Everything needed to render the photo from the original.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same prompt and seed give the same result; leave it out for a fresh one, or change it for a different take.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that generates it, recorded by the app.

options.title: Options
options.description: Seeds of alternative takes offered to pick from, recorded by the app.

aspect.title: Aspect
aspect.description: Grow the frame to this width:height, centered on the photo; "free" adds the side amounts below instead.

left.title: Left
left.description: Add this fraction of the width on the left.

right.title: Right
right.description: Add this fraction of the width on the right.

top.title: Top
top.description: Add this fraction of the height on top.

bottom.title: Bottom
bottom.description: Add this fraction of the height at the bottom.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: What the new area should show; empty continues the scene naturally.

Expand.title: Expand
Expand.description:
Expand the canvas: extend the photo past its edges, with new surroundings painted by
a generative model to match (outpainting). Use it to turn a vertical photo into a
landscape one, or to give a tight shot more room, without cropping anything away. Masks
and later crops refer to the expanded frame.

keep_location.title: Keep Location
keep_location.description: Keep GPS location from the original. Off by default for privacy.

upscale.title: Upscale
upscale.description: Enlarge the export with an AI upscaler (up to 8000 pixels across).

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: Exposure change in stops; +1 doubles light.

Exposure.title: Exposure
Exposure.description: Brighten or darken the whole photo, like changing the camera exposure.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same prompt and seed give the same result; leave it out for a fresh one, or change it for a different take.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that generates it, recorded by the app.

options.title: Options
options.description: Seeds of alternative takes offered to pick from, recorded by the app.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: What to put there, in plain words.

grow.title: Grow
grow.description: How far past the selection's edge to repaint, for a seamless blend.

Generate.title: Generate
Generate.description:
Generative fill: paint new content where the layer's mask selects, described in
words ("a potted plant", "a sunset sky", "calm water"). The model blends it into the
photo's light and perspective. Needs a mask; it is the only operation in its layer, and
like removals it applies before any adjustment layer.

hue.title: Hue
hue.description: Shift the band's hue toward its neighbors.

HSL.title: HSL
HSL.description: Adjust hue, saturation, and luminance of one color band (e.g. deepen blue skies).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: How readily spots are healed; higher finds more.

size.title: Size
size.description: Largest spot to heal; higher heals bigger spots.

HealBlemishes.title: HealBlemishes
HealBlemishes.description:
Find small spots (blemishes, pimples, dust) and heal them from the skin around them.
Use on a layer masked to skin.

Highlights.title: Highlights
Highlights.description: Recover (negative) or boost (positive) the brightest areas without touching shadows.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable id; new layers get one from `new_layer_id`.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: 0 is no effect, 100 is full effect.

blend_mode.title: Blend Mode
blend_mode.description: How the layer's result combines with the layers below: normal replaces them; luminosity changes only brightness (contrast without color shifts); color changes only color; multiply darkens; screen lightens; overlay and soft_light add contrast.

mask.title: Mask
mask.description: Limits the layer to part of the photo; null applies it everywhere.

Layer.title: Layer
Layer.description: A named group of adjustments with its own visibility, opacity, and blend mode.

distortion.title: Distortion
distortion.description: Positive straightens lines that bow outward (barrel); negative straightens lines that bow inward (pincushion).

LensCorrection.title: LensCorrection
LensCorrection.description:
Undo lens distortion: straight lines that bow outward (barrel, wide angle) or inward
(pincushion, telephoto). Scales up just enough that no edge is left empty.

invert.title: Invert
invert.description: Swap where the layer applies and where it does not.

start.title: Start
start.description: [x, y] as fractions of the photo.

end.title: End
end.description: [x, y] as fractions of the photo.

LinearGradientMask.title: LinearGradientMask
LinearGradientMask.description:
Full effect on the `start` side, fading to none at `end`. For skies, use a start at
the top and an end a little below the horizon.

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: How much of the look to use.

invert.title: Invert
invert.description: Swap where the layer applies and where it does not.

LuminosityMask.title: LuminosityMask
LuminosityMask.description:
Applies to tones between `low` and `high` brightness (0 black, 1 white). For example
0.65 to 1 targets highlights, 0 to 0.35 shadows.

state.description: The complete edit state after the change.

coalesce.title: Coalesce
coalesce.description: What was tweaked, e.g. one slider. Repeated tweaks with the same key update the previous step instead of adding another.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: The layers to keep. Brush masks are dropped, since they only fit the photo they were painted on.

NoiseReduction.title: NoiseReduction
NoiseReduction.description: Smooth out grain and color speckles, typical of low-light photos.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: Positive widens the top, for verticals that lean in toward the top (camera tilted up); negative widens the bottom.

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: Positive widens the right side, for lines that converge toward the right; negative widens the left.

Perspective.title: Perspective
Perspective.description:
Fix lines that converge because the camera was tilted: buildings that lean in toward
the top, or a wall that shrinks toward one side. The narrow side is stretched out to the
frame, so nothing is left empty.

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description:
What the agent means to do for a multi-step request, shown before the slow or
generative steps run, so the person can approve or change it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: adjust: quick slider-style edits; ai: runs an AI model to select, remove, or retouch; generative: paints new pixels with an image generation model.

invert.title: Invert
invert.description: Swap where the layer applies and where it does not.

center.title: Center
center.description: [x, y] as fractions of the photo.

radius_x.title: Radius X
radius_x.description: Half-width as a fraction of photo width.

radius_y.title: Radius Y
radius_y.description: Half-height as a fraction of photo height.

RadialGradientMask.title: RadialGradientMask
RadialGradientMask.description:
Full effect inside an ellipse, fading out toward its edge. Invert it to affect
everything outside instead (for example, to darken around a subject).

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same prompt and seed give the same result; leave it out for a fresh one, or change it for a different take.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that generates it, recorded by the app.

options.title: Options
options.description: Seeds of alternative takes offered to pick from, recorded by the app.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Where the light comes from; back is a rim light from behind.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The light's color and mood; empty is soft daylight.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: How much of the new light to use.

Relight.title: Relight
Relight.description:
Change the light: where it comes from and its mood ("warm sunset light", "cool
moonlight", "neon purple"), as an AI relighting model imagines the scene lit that way.
Best for portraits and products; give the layer a mask on the subject to relight only
it. Fine detail stays from the photo. The only operation in its layer.

grow.title: Grow
grow.description: How far past the selection's edge to fill, so outlines and halos go.

Remove.title: Remove
Remove.description:
Remove what the layer's mask selects (a person, power lines, a sign) and fill the gap
with plausible surroundings, using an AI inpainting model. Needs a mask; it is the only
operation in its layer. Removal layers apply first, before any adjustment layer.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same prompt and seed give the same result; leave it out for a fresh one, or change it for a different take.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that generates it, recorded by the app.

options.title: Options
options.description: Seeds of alternative takes offered to pick from, recorded by the app.

harmonize.title: Harmonize
harmonize.description: How much to match the subject's light and color to the new scene.

ReplaceBackground.title: ReplaceBackground
ReplaceBackground.description:
Replace the background with a new scene described in words ("a sunlit beach",
"a softly lit studio, pale gray"), painted around the subject so its perspective fits,
and match the subject's light and color to it. The layer's mask selects what to
replace; without one, everything but the main subject. The only operation in its layer;
applies before adjustments.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same prompt and seed give the same result; leave it out for a fresh one, or change it for a different take.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that generates it, recorded by the app.

options.title: Options
options.description: Seeds of alternative takes offered to pick from, recorded by the app.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: How much of the restored faces to use; lower keeps more of the original.

RestoreFaces.title: RestoreFaces
RestoreFaces.description:
Restore faces in an old, blurry, or low-resolution photo with an AI face restoration
model: sharper eyes, skin, and hair that still look like the person. Only faces change.
The only operation in its layer.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same prompt and seed give the same result; leave it out for a fresh one, or change it for a different take.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that generates it, recorded by the app.

options.title: Options
options.description: Seeds of alternative takes offered to pick from, recorded by the app.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The style to redraw it in.

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: How far it may stray from the photo; higher is more stylized.

Restyle.title: Restyle
Restyle.description:
Redraw the whole photo in a style ("watercolor painting", "1970s film photo",
"Studio Ghibli anime") with an image generation model, keeping its composition. Use
only when asked for a new style or medium; for a color look, use color_grade and the
other adjustments instead. The only operation in its layer.

remove_blemishes.title: Remove Blemishes
remove_blemishes.description: Heal small spots on the skin.

whiten_teeth.title: Whiten Teeth
whiten_teeth.description: Take the yellow out of teeth.

Retouch.title: Retouch
Retouch.description: How much of each retouch to do; 0 leaves that part out.

Rotate.title: Rotate
Rotate.description: Rotate the photo clockwise by a quarter, half, or three-quarter turn.

Saturation.title: Saturation
Saturation.description: Uniformly increase or decrease color intensity; -100 makes black and white.

include.title: Include
include.description: False marks a spot that is not part of it.

invert.title: Invert
invert.description: Swap where the layer applies and where it does not.

target.title: Target
target.description: subject: the main subject, as a cutout would keep it; people: every person; sky; object: one thing you point at with `box` and/or `points` (a particular person, a dog, a car); and parts of faces for portraits: skin (face and visible skin), face, eyes, lips, teeth, hair.

box.title: Box
box.description: For object: [left, top, right, bottom] around it, fractions of the photo.

points.title: Points
points.description: For object: spots on it (or, with include false, not).

description.title: Description
description.description: What is selected, in plain words: "the dog".

strokes.title: Strokes
strokes.description: Brush touch-ups painted by the person over what the model found: added where painted, taken away where erased. Keep them when changing the mask.

SemanticMask.title: SemanticMask
SemanticMask.description:
Selects something by what it is, found by an AI model: the sky, the main subject,
people, a particular object, or parts of a face. For `object`, give a `box` around it
(and optionally `points` on it), in fractions of the photo as you see it.

Shadows.title: Shadows
Shadows.description: Lift (positive) or deepen (negative) the darkest areas without touching highlights.

texture.title: Texture
texture.description: How much fine skin texture to keep.

SmoothSkin.title: SmoothSkin
SmoothSkin.description:
Soften skin while keeping its natural texture (pores, fine lines stay, blotches and
uneven tone go). Use on a layer masked to skin; subtle amounts (20-40) look natural.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: One named change to the photo and the edit state it left behind.

Straighten.title: Straighten
Straighten.description: Rotate by a small angle to level a tilted horizon, cropping away the empty corners.

description.title: Description
description.description: One friendly sentence on what it does.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: The layers picking it adds on top.

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Ask again instead of reusing earlier ideas.

ToneCurve.title: ToneCurve

Vibrance.title: Vibrance
Vibrance.description: Boost or reduce saturation mostly in muted colors, protecting skin and saturated areas.

midpoint.title: Midpoint
midpoint.description: How far in the effect reaches; lower is wider.

Vignette.title: Vignette
Vignette.description: Darken (negative) or lighten (positive) the edges to draw the eye inward.

tint.title: Tint
tint.description: Positive is more magenta, negative more green.

WhiteBalance.title: WhiteBalance
WhiteBalance.description: Shift color temperature and tint to fix a color cast or set a mood.

Whites.title: Whites
Whites.description: Move the white point: positive makes the brightest tones brighter, negative dims them.

ChatMessage.description: What the browser sends over the chat WebSocket.

approve_plan.description: Go ahead with the plan the agent proposed in its last reply.
approve_plan.title: Approve Plan

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
